purpose: PR #131 fixed issue #103 (missing shared skill-reference files in exports) but explicitly left its standalone-installation check for #104. This record is that check, run against the packaged candidate ZIP rather than the source dist tree.

environment.systemToolchains: node/npm removed from PATH for the child process
environment.installRoot: isolated temp directory with a space and a non-ASCII character in its path
environment.projectRoot: isolated temp directory with a space and a non-ASCII character in its path

checks.check: install and sync succeed with system node/npm absent from PATH
relative links from latchkit-build/SKILL.md ('../references/efficiency.md', '../references/workflow-evidence.md') resolve to files that exist on disk

limitations: Covers the requirements/spec/build/review skill selection only, not every bundled skill.

This is a manual black-box CLI check, not an additional automated regression test; automated coverage for this defect lives in test/pack-index.test.js and related suites, which passed in this qualification's npm test run.
